title: Maps, Plans and Models
summary: Using scale to measure maps and plans, interpreting elevation and floor plans, route planning with distance, speed, time and fuel cost, and building scale models.

items: **Number scale** 1 : 200 000: 1 cm on the map = 200 000 cm = 2 km.
**Bar scale**: measure the bar with a ruler first, e.g. if 3 cm on the bar = 5 km, then 1 cm = 1,67 km.
**Finding the scale**: map distance : real distance, in the **same units**, simplified to 1 : …

notes.title: Worked example 1: using a bar scale
notes.problem: On a map, the bar scale shows 4 cm = 10 km. Two towns are 13,2 cm apart on the map. What is the real distance?

notes.title: Worked example 2: a road trip
notes.problem: A family drives 1 400 km from Johannesburg to Cape Town at an average of 100 km/h. Their car uses 8,2 ℓ/100 km and petrol costs R23,60/ℓ. Calculate the driving time and fuel cost.
notes.answer: 14 h of driving; R2 709,28 for fuel

notes.label: Exam tip
notes.text: Remember to add stops, toll fees and the return trip if the question mentions them. Convert decimal hours to hours and minutes: 0,75 h = 45 min.
Floor plans give lengths and widths; elevation plans give heights. Combine them to find areas of walls (for paint or bricks) and volumes of rooms (for air-conditioning or heating).

notes.title: Worked example 3
notes.problem: A classroom is 9 m × 7 m (floor plan) and 3 m high (elevation). An air-conditioner is rated for 200 m³. Is it large enough?

notes.text: To build a scale model, divide every real measurement by the scale factor. A 1 : 50 model of a 12 m × 8 m hall has a base of 24 cm × 16 cm.

questions.prompt: On a 1 : 250 000 map, a road is 6,4 cm long. What is its real length in km?
A bar scale shows 2 cm = 5 km. Two places are 9 cm apart on the map. What is the real distance?
A 15 m wall is drawn as 10 cm on a plan. What is the scale?
A truck travels 630 km at an average speed of 84 km/h. How many hours does the trip take?
A 1 : 40 scale model of a 6 m long bus is built. How long is the model, in cm?
3,4 hours is the same as 3 hours 40 minutes.
questions.explanation: 0,4 h = 24 minutes, so 3,4 h = 3 h 24 min.

questions.prompt: A taxi owner drives 85 km each way to work, 22 days a month. The taxi uses 11 ℓ/100 km and diesel costs R22,90/ℓ. Calculate the monthly fuel cost.
A bus leaves Durban at 21:30 and travels 600 km to Johannesburg at an average of 75 km/h, with a 40-minute stop. When does it arrive?
questions.memo:
✓ 600 ÷ 75 = 8 h (1)
✓ + 40 min = 8 h 40 min (1)
✓ Arrives 06:10 the next day (1)

questions.prompt: A hall is 20 m long, 12 m wide and 4,5 m high. A heater is rated for 900 m³. Is it suitable? Show working.
Why are both a floor plan and an elevation plan needed to calculate how much paint is needed for the walls of a room?
questions.memo:
✓ The floor plan gives the lengths of the walls (1)
✓ The elevation plan gives the heights, so the wall area can be calculated (1)
